visual: Compact rounded shrub with small grey-green leaves and warm orange-yellow five-petalled flowers, often orange when opening before fading towards yellow
water: Moderate while establishing; drought tolerant once established
soil: Well-drained loam or sandy soil; neutral to alkaline
soilWarning: Avoid persistently wet, compacted or heavy poorly drained clay
prune: Lightly prune in spring; remove older stems periodically to maintain a compact, vigorous framework
toxicity: Ornamental fruit not for eating; gloves advised when handling
resilience: Very hardy; tolerant of exposed sites, cold and periods of drought once established
uses: Shrub borders, low hedging, banks, gravel gardens, wildlife gardens, containers

visual: Upright deciduous shrub with green lobed foliage and large semi-double pink flowers with a deep crimson-red centre; petals fade to paler pink with age
water: Moderate; keep watered during establishment and prolonged hot dry periods
soil: Moist but well-drained, fertile soil; adaptable to loam, clay and sandy soils
soilWarning: Avoid permanently waterlogged soil; flowering is reduced in cold or heavily shaded positions
prune: Prune to shape in late winter or early spring; cutting shoots back can encourage larger flowers
resilience: Cold-hardy in much of the UK; tolerant of summer heat and some drought once established but flowers best in a warm sheltered site
uses: Specimen shrub, borders, flowering hedge, screening, courtyard gardens, large containers

visual: Trailing tropical plant with small glossy fleshy dark-green leaves and striking inflated orange to orange-red tubular flowers resembling tiny goldfish
water: Water when the upper compost begins to dry; keep lightly and evenly moist during active growth and reduce watering in winter
aspect: Bright filtered light / East or West window
soil: Airy, fertile, free-draining peat-free houseplant compost
soilWarning: Avoid waterlogging, dense compost and prolonged cold wet conditions
prune: Pinch young shoot tips to encourage branching; trim long stems after flowering if required
resilience: Tender tropical evergreen; performs well indoors with warmth, bright filtered light and good drainage
uses: Houseplant, hanging basket, conservatory, greenhouse, trailing container display
